digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: After one successful new-writer save, the last_get_pass inline field must be absent from every entry in bindings.json while preserving all other fields.
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline field retained as a failure floor for recovery.
A crash or failure after sidecar persist but before bindings replace must not lose the maximum rotation value; the max must already be durable in the sidecar.
An old-writer followed by new-writer sequence must migrate any reintroduced later inline stamp into get_rotation.json and then scrub it from bindings.json.
The save operation must atomically merge staged inline rotation values into sidecar, persist sidecar first, then remove inline fields and persist bindings only on successful sidecar write.
